title: Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu Part 2 - Eris no Goblin Toubatsu
justification: AniList 141534 has 1 episode (2022-03-16; 'Eris the Goblin Slayer', 'Bangai-hen - Eris no Goblin Toubatsu'). AniDB 15954 S1 'Extra Episode: Eris the Goblin Slayer' (番外編 エリスのゴブリン討伐) is dated 2022-03-16. TVDB 371310 0x01 'Eris the Goblin Slayer' is dated 2022-03-16 (abs 17). The node's row sends S1 there; the other 16 specials (the 2021-09-27 pre-broadcast special and the opening/ending clips) are not the AniList episode, and S2-S17 are shifted by the row's offset -17 to nonpositive numbers (unmapped).
